task_description: Build WattWise — a complete, competition-ready electricity tariff intelligence web app on top of the existing TariffCompare React/Vite project. Migrate all .jsx/.js source to .tsx/.ts, implement five novelties (Digital Twin, Break-Even Explorer, Risk Shield, Regret Guard, Peak Shift Advisor), add Google Auth context, all required routes, Kiro specs, Firestore integration, Recharts visualisations, and a comprehensive Vitest test suite.
